title: Computationally Designed Molecules Modulate ALS-Related Amyloidogenic TDP-43(307-319) Aggregation.
authors: Liu, Xikun; Duan, Shuya; Jin, Yingying; Walker, Ethan; Tsao, Michelle; Jang, Joshua H; Chen, Ziying; Singh, Ambuj K; Cantrell, Kristi Lazar; Ingolfsson, Helgi I; Buratto, Steven K; Bowers, Michael T
one_liner_zh: 该文用计算设计分子抑制TDP-43淀粉样聚集，虽涉及蛋白寡聚体与MD模拟，但对象为蛋白自身聚集而非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: Abnormal cytosolic aggregation of TAR DNA-binding protein of 43 kDa (TDP-43) is observed in multiple diseases, including amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), frontotemporal lobar degeneration, and Alzheimer's disease. Previous studies have shown that TDP-43(307-319) located at the C-terminal of TDP-43 can form higher-order oligomers and fibrils. Of particular interest are the hexamers that adopt a cylindrin structure that has been strongly correlated to neurotoxicity. In this study, we use the joint pharmacophore space (JPS) model to identify and generate potential TDP-43 inhibitors. Five JPS-designed molecules are evaluated using both experimental and computational methods: ion mobility mass spectrometry, thioflavin T fluorescence assay, circular dichroism spectroscopy, atomic force microscopy, and molecular dynamics simulations. We found that all five molecules can prevent the amyloid fibril formation of TDP-43(307-319), but their efficacy varies significantly. Furthermore, among the five molecules, [AC0101] is the most efficient in preventing the formation of higher-order oligomers and dissociating preformed higher-order oligomers. Molecular dynamics simulations show that [AC0101] both is the most flexible and forms the most hydrogen bonds with the TDP-43(307-319) monomer. The JPS-designed molecules can insert themselves between the beta-strands in the hexameric cylindrin structure of TDP-43(307-319) and can open its structure. Possible mechanisms for JPS-designed molecules to inhibit and dissociate TDP-43(307-319) oligomers on an atomistic scale are proposed.
abstract_zh: 在多种疾病中，包括肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）、额颞叶变性及阿尔茨海默病，均观察到43 kDa TAR DNA结合蛋白（TDP-43）的异常胞质聚集。既往研究表明，位于TDP-43 C端的TDP-43(307-319)可形成高阶寡聚体和纤维。特别值得注意的是，采用圆柱蛋白结构（cylindrin）的六聚体与神经毒性密切相关。在本研究中，我们利用联合药效团空间（JPS）模型来识别和生成潜在的TDP-43抑制剂。通过实验和计算方法评估了五种JPS设计的分子：离子迁移质谱法、硫黄素T荧光测定、圆二色谱法、原子力显微镜及分子动力学模拟。我们发现所有五种分子均能阻止TDP-43(307-319)的淀粉样纤维形成，但其效果差异显著。此外，在这五种分子中，[AC0101]在阻止高阶寡聚体形成及解离预形成的高阶寡聚体方面最为有效。分子动力学模拟显示，[AC0101]既具有最大的灵活性，又与TDP-43(307-319)单体形成最多的氢键。JPS设计的分子能插入TDP-43(307-319)六聚体圆柱蛋白结构中的β链之间，并能打开其结构。我们提出了JPS设计分子在原子尺度上抑制和解离TDP-43(307-319)寡聚体的可能机制。
